revenueModel.text: It earns the spread between interest earned and interest paid.
revenueModel.evidence: We derive our income mainly from the difference or "spread" between the interest earned on loans, securities and other interest-earning assets and interest paid on deposits, borrowings and other interest-bearing liabilities.
